mathematical_definition: rolling(60).sum(|diff(close > rolling(60).median(close))|) -- count of times the close crossed its own trailing 60-bar median over the trailing 60 bars, a reversal-frequency proxy
missing_value_policy: NaN for the first ~121 bars (the inner rolling(60).median needs 60 bars, the diff() adds 1 more, then the outer rolling(60).sum needs 60 more), never zero-filled
